explanation: The UAV collided with a moving obstacle at 4.0 seconds due to a combination of environmental and operational factors. The crosswind of 3.1 m/s and the high cruise speed of 9.3 m/s reduced the UAV's ability to maneuver, while the late detection of the obstacle limited the reaction time to only 1.2 seconds. Counterfactual analysis confirms that removing the wind, reducing speed, or eliminating the late-appearing obstacle would have prevented the collision.
